objective: Explore all Sunday weekly closed sessions 2020-2026 for more coverage than 8 historical recovery checkpoints. Preserve the EXACT fixed v8.2 weekly-trend and breadth conditions with no threshold tuning.
temporalContract: Every report row for Sunday d is known at 00:00 UTC on Monday after d closed; only closed daily prices through Sunday d. 30wk SMA, 4week slope, previous 4week high/low CLOSE extrema, ETH/BTC rel30 and 6 alt broad participation exactly v8.2.
rows: All Sundays starting 2020-01-05 until latest FULL Sunday 2026-10-11 with history for 34 Sunday weekly closes; keep missing breadth explicit as INSUFFICIENT_DATA, not ZERO.
outcomes: Subsequent 4,13,26,52 weeks BTC close-to-close % change, max adverse and max favorable daily close change within horizon, or RIGHT_CENSORED; no trade P&L
pastOnlyPhase: At each Sunday join v8.0 confirmed phase and risk label (if available) for descriptive stratification, no hindsight labeling.
nonoverlap: One 13-week spaced series starting at the FIRST Sunday with available 34-week BTC history. Include every 13th Sunday thereafter regardless of cohort, and preserve missingness and right censoring. This is anchor-dependent, not IID.
comparisons: Report all eligible Sundays, 13-week nonoverlap anchors, by cohort, by 2020–2023 vs 2024–2026, full numbers and simple unconditional BTC outcome. Do not show p-values or calibrated accuracy; overlapping observations highly correlated.
transitions: Report weekly-confirmed changes false->true and true->false, timestamps and 13w outcomes, count; no backdating changes
forbidden: No threshold optimization or hindsight cherry picking
No spot system-price inference from Binance USDM close
No retrofilled alt data where exchange future contract was not listed
No ETF macro vintages silently projected to past periods
No live trading or portfolio/Futures/NAV/risk changes
caveat: Still an exploratory model on inspected 2020-2026 history; even 13-week anchors not guaranteed independent and cohort imbalances matter.
